_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Accessibility.HighContrastTip: Over any look: heavier outlines on a dark rim, a strong shadow and solid colours
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Accessibility.ReduceMotionTip: Effects that move play as simple fades or hold still
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Accessibility.ShapeCuesTip: A bar running low, like magicka while channelling, also narrows instead of only changing colour
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.AddOns.AddOnGapTip: Space between the built-in bars and the ring
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.AddOns.AddOnRingTip: Outside the built-in bars, so they never overlap them. Off puts them in the same spots
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.AddOns.AddOnStopped: Stopped after an error in this add-on, see ReticleArcs.log
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Bars.BowColourSourceTip: Element: fire, frost and shock arrows and bolts have their own colours
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Bars.ColourSourceTip: Element: fire, frost, shock, sun, poison and drain spells have their own colours, other harmful spells their casting light's
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Bars.ColourSources: Fixed|Spell school|Element|Element, else school|Add-on, else element or school|Add-on, else fixed
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Bars.CrossbowTip: Where the bow bar goes while reloading a crossbow, in both views
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Compatibility.HudNGTip: Reads HUD NG's saved layout. Moves made in its editor apply once saved
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Compatibility.PerfHitchShare: Reticle Arcs in the worst hitch
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Compatibility.PerfMeasuring: Measuring, the first results in 10 seconds
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Compatibility.RecordPerformanceTip: Times Reticle Arcs' work every frame against the game's frames. Summaries and hitches go to ReticleArcs.log, every frame to ReticleArcs-perf.csv
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Compatibility.SmoothCamTip: Follows its 3D crosshair. Relies on SmoothCam's internals, an update may break it
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Compatibility.TDMTip: True Directional Movement's target lock, when not using free aim
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.BreakTip: A charge lost to a stagger, a hit or sheathing, not a release
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.ChannelTip: Spells held to keep casting, like Flames: the bar drains with your magicka
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.DualFlourishTip: Plays when a dual cast is ready. By element: fire, frost, shock, sun, poison and drain spells each have their own
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.DualNeedsOpposite: Needs the spell bars on opposite sides
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.DualNotEither: The spell bars aren't on opposite sides, it won't play
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.DualNotFirst: Not in first person: the spell bars aren't on opposite sides there
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.DualNotThird: Not in third person: the spell bars aren't on opposite sides there
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.DualOtherTip: Dual casts of spells without an element, like healing
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.MagickaWarningTip: A spell you can't afford, an empty staff or a bow with no arrows lights up its bar in this colour
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.ShoutTiersTip: Each word of a shout a little brighter than the one before
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Feedback.StaffChargeTip: A rim when a staff has one cast left, the warning when it's empty, and its charge while channelling
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.BashHitsTip: A knocked mark for shield and weapon bashes, even with Melee off
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.BlockedHitsTip: A dull, split mark when the target blocks, even with Ranged or Melee off
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.HitStyleTip: A mark around the crosshair when a hit lands
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.KillsTip: A mark for every kill, even with Ranged or Melee off
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.PowerAttackTip: A flourish on power attacks, even those without a mark
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.SneakAttackTip: A flourish on sneak attacks, ranged or melee, even those without a mark. Spells need Magic Sneak Attacks
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.TakenBlockedTip: Hits stopped by your shield or weapon, shown fainter
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.TakenColourTip: Melee, arrows and spells without an element
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.TakenDistanceTip: How far outside the bars the marks sit
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.TakenFollowTip: The mark turns with your view to keep pointing at who hit you
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.TakenHitsTip: A mark outside the bars pointing to where a hit on you came from
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.HitIndicators.TakenSpellTip: In the colour of the spell's element
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Look.FadeOutTip: How long a bar takes to fade once the charge ends
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Look.FadeOutUnused: Only used when a bar is released with Fade, or interrupted with Just fade
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Look.FlashTip: A short effect once the charge is full
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Look.GlowTip: A soft light around the fill
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Look.ReleaseTip: How the bar goes once the charge is used
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Look.SeparateTip: Turning it off copies the bow's look to the others
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Preview.MakeRoomTip: Moves this window aside for the preview
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Profiles.BundledTip: Comes with the mod and gets replaced on updates, use Save as new
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Profiles.ProfileTip: A saved look and layout, picking one loads it
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Profiles.UndoChangesTip: Back to the profile as saved
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Profiles.UpdateProfileTip: Saves the changes into this profile
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Save.UndoTip: Back to the settings as they were when this page was opened. Changes are saved as you make them
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.HalfAngleTip: How far the bar reaches either side of its middle
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.OrnamentsTip: Small shapes past each end, in the outline colour
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.OutlineAccentTip: A second colour on the outline. Bevel lights it from the top left
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.OutlineTip: Line around the track, 0 for none
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.PaddingTip: How much track shows around the fill
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.ShadingTip: Gradient is lighter along the middle, lengthwise towards the middle of the bar
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.Shape.ShadowTip: Behind the track, for bright backgrounds
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.SizeAndPosition.FollowCrosshairTip: Follows the crosshair when something moves it, like SmoothCam
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.SizeAndPosition.FollowSmoothingTip: How long it takes to catch up, 0 is instant
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.SizeAndPosition.OffsetTip: Moves everything away from the crosshair
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.SizeAndPosition.OpacityTip: Opacity of the bars and hit indicators
line:menu_translation/reticle-arcs:SKSE/.SizeAndPosition.ScaleTip: Size of the bars and hit indicators
